title: Write a travel story
description: Short writing tasks about experiences and travel stories.

items.prompt: Write a short paragraph about a memorable trip. Use Present Perfect and Past Simple.
items.promptIt: Scrivi un breve paragrafo su un viaggio memorabile. Usa Present Perfect e Past Simple.

items.prompt: Write one Have you ever...? question and your own answer.
items.promptIt: Scrivi una domanda Have you ever...? e la tua risposta.
